tours.name: Denakil
tours.description: An expedition to the Danakil Depression — one of the hottest and most otherworldly places on Earth: lava lakes, salt flats and neon sulphur springs.
details: Visit Erta Ale volcano, the Dallol sulphur springs and the salt caravans of the Afar region.
Includes 4x4 transport from Addis Ababa, an experienced local guide, all meals and camping equipment.
Nights are spent camping under the stars — basic conditions, unforgettable views.
Departs with a minimum of 2 travellers; bring sun protection, sturdy shoes and a sense of adventure.

tours.name: Lalibela Rock-Hewn Churches
tours.description: Fly north to the rock-hewn wonders of Lalibela — churches carved straight into the mountain, with a local guide and all transfers included.
details: Guided tour of both clusters of the 12th-century rock-hewn churches, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Includes transfers, entrance fees and a licensed local guide.
One night in a local hotel with breakfast included.
Dress modestly for the churches — shoulders and knees covered; shoes come off at the door.

tours.name: Harar City Tour
tours.description: Wander the walled old town of Harar — 368 alleyways, colourful markets, coffee at the source and the famous hyena feeders at night.
details: Guided walk through the UNESCO-listed Jugol old town, its markets and traditional Harari houses.
Coffee tasting in the region where coffee was first cultivated.
Evening visit to the hyena men — watch wild hyenas fed by hand, a Harar tradition.
Includes a local guide and entrance fees.

tours.name: Omo Valley Cultural Tour
tours.description: A guided journey through the Omo Valley visiting local communities and markets — one of Africa's most remarkable cultural regions.
details: Visit the communities of the lower Omo Valley — including the Hamar, Mursi and Kara — with a respectful local guide.
Time your trip with the weekly markets at Turmi, Dimeka or Key Afer.
Includes transport, guide, accommodation and park/community fees.
A long overland journey — expect early starts, rough roads and huge rewards.

tours.name: Addis City Tour
tours.description: Get your bearings in Addis and make the best of your short time — the National Museum, Merkato, Entoto Hills and a proper coffee ceremony, all in one day.
details: Meet Lucy at the National Museum, haggle (gently) in Merkato — Africa's biggest open market — and take in the view from Entoto Hills.
Includes a traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony and lunch at a local favourite.
Transport and a local guide included; runs with 1–3 travellers.
Group deal: every additional guest gets 30% off (up to 3 people per tour).
